'''Spray splints''' were medical tools. They were used to protect broken [[Bone/Legends|bones]] that had been immobilized by a [[Bone stabilizer/Legends|bone stabilizer]]. Spray splints were included in [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]]' [[FastFlesh medpac/Legends|FastFlesh medpac]].<ref name="EGWT" />
